title.narrative: Scaling up Malaria Prevention, Treatment and Control Interventions in Liberia for Sustained Impact - Liberia (01-Dec-2022-30-Jun-2024)

description.narrative: Liberia, Malaria, Catholic Relief Services - United States Conference of Catholic Bishops (CRS Liberia)This program has the following goals: By end of 2025, reduce malaria burden by 75% (11% overall prevalence) compared to 2016 (45% prevalence). The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: By end of 2025, reduce malaria mortality rates by at least 75% (43/100,000 population) compared to 2016 (172/100,000 population). Objective 2: By end of 2025, reduce malaria case incidence by at least 75% (95/1,000 population) compared to 2016 (380/1,000 population). Objective 3: By end of 2025, promote and maintain a culture of evidence-based decision making to achieve malaria program performance at all levels. title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for LBR-M-CRSP01
Malaria parasite prevalence: Proportion of children aged 6-59 months with malaria infection
In-patient malaria deaths: rate per 100,000 persons per year
Outcome indicators targets and results for LBR-M-CRSP01
Proportion of children under five years old who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of population with access to an ITN within their household
Proportion of pregnant women who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for LBR-M-CRSP01
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at private sector sites
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Timeliness of facility reporting: Percentage of submitted facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Completeness of facility reporting: Percentage of expected facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at private sector sites
